title: The gold pot, put away
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Tuesday, after the shop. The gold pot goes into the shack's loft for winter. Gully lifts it up; the uncle says careful from the chair; the pot goes up. Fifteen layers of gold and a chip. Wood draws it going up the ladder into the dark. It comes down in February. The uncle won't see it.

panels.composition: The shack. GULLY on a ladder lifting the gold pot into the loft. The UNCLE in the door in the chair. WOOD, BARNABY.

image.prompt: a stocky teenager on a ladder lifting a gold-painted crab pot into a shack's loft while an old man in a lawn chair watches from the doorway, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The pot going into the dark of the loft. The chip on the rim catching the last light.

image.prompt: close on a gold-painted crab pot being pushed into a dark loft, its chipped rim catching light, black and white, no words
an old man in a lawn chair watching something disappear into a loft, his face unreadable, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The shack. The ladder down. The loft dark. February, it comes down. The strip doesn't know who'll be in the chair. It draws the chair.

image.prompt: a shingle shack interior with a ladder laid down and a dark loft above, an old man in a lawn chair in the doorway, black and white, no words
image.notes: The uncle dies Feb 2001. The strip doesn't know. It draws the chair.
